comparison.objective: Assemble a drive-chain joint, versus preassemble an ER32 collet and nut.
comparison.physical_skill: Align chain links and insert/secure joint components; candidate aligns an eccentric extraction groove and rolls the collet into a retaining ring.
comparison.success_condition: Requires a complete retained chain joint with its locking hardware; candidate requires released ring retention and light pull resistance. Candidate numeric tolerances are absent.
comparison.reason: Shared alignment and retention primitives do not make the distinct joint mechanisms equivalent.
